Soul Gas (requires Essence 3 to install) — victims roll Stamina + Resistance (difficulty 1 for magical beings, 4 for mortals); failure costs a temporary dot from every Virtue except Compassion and forces a Valor roll (difficulty 2), and failing that roll causes the victim to flee at best speed and suffer a one-die penalty to non-reflexive actions for an hour; a filter reduces the difficulty by 1.
cost: Varies (motes spent shape the cloud's size, capped at Manipulation per turn); Installation Cost: 1 mote.
compatibility: Duration: Instant (the resulting cloud persists per the duration rules above). Type: Reflexive. Close Combat Charms tree (Manipulation-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Close Combat Charms' tree, pp. 98-100 (PDF 99-101); visually cross-checked against the Close Combat Charms IV tree diagram. Spans three printed pages due to the four named gas submodules.

name: Perfected Lotus Matrix
summary: A skull-mounted memory-crystal port that lets an Alchemical learn and use ordinary Terrestrial or Celestial Martial Arts Charms the same way any other Celestial Exalt would, storing them independently of Charm Slots; the mandatory prerequisite for any Alchemical who wants to be a supernatural martial artist.
requirements: Minimum Martial Arts 2; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: None. Because it is not Attribute-based, this Charm is never Favored or Caste for any Alchemical and must occupy a General Charm Slot.
mechanics: Enables the Alchemical to comprehend and learn Terrestrial- or Celestial-level Martial Arts Charms exactly as any other Celestial Exalted, at a cost of 6 bonus points or 11 xp each; these Charms need no Charm Slots of their own, instead stored as submodule-like programs in the Matrix's memory crystals. Master sifus may even develop entirely new styles as Solar Exalted can (Exalted Players Guide, p. 232). Removing the Perfected Lotus Matrix suspends access to every Martial Arts Charm stored in it until it is reinstalled. Alchemical martial artists may still build ordinary Combos of their Martial Arts Charms at the usual cost and difficulty, but cannot mix in their Attribute-based Charms.
compatibility: Duration: N/A. Type: Permanent. Close Combat Charms tree (Martial Arts-keyed; General Slot only).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Close Combat Charms' tree, p. 100 (PDF 101). This is the specific Charm referenced by name in the pre-existing alchemical-bonus-points-and-experience-costs row's Martial Arts Charm cost line.

name: Alchemical Martial Artists (available Autochthonian styles)
summary: A short sidebar noting that Vat Complexes preserve records of numerous Terrestrial and Celestial martial arts styles — including Creation's animal styles and native Autochthonian techniques developed for Alchemicals using advanced cognitive Charms — and lists the specific published styles Alchemical characters may take via the Perfected Lotus Matrix.
mechanics: Available styles (or indistinguishable local variants) explicitly listed: Snake, Tiger, Mantis, Ebon Shadow, Celestial Monkey, Righteous Devil, Violet Bier of Sorrows, Five Dragon, and Jade Mountain.
compatibility: All Alchemical castes with the Perfected Lotus Matrix installed.
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Alchemical Martial Artists' sidebar, p. 100 (PDF 101). Classified reference-only rather than selectable because it is a curated style-availability list, not a discrete purchasable Trait of its own; the styles' actual Charms are standard published Martial Arts Charms outside this book's scope, while Perfected Lotus Matrix is the selectable row that grants access to them.

name: Aim-Calibrating Sensors
summary: A forehead-mounted rangefinder and targeting implant that strips environmental and situational penalties away from an Alchemical's ranged attacks.
requirements: Minimum Perception 2; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: None.
mechanics: For every mote spent, remove one die of environmental or situational penalty from a ranged attack roll (range, wind, cover short of 100%, shields, low light, and similar factors); every 2 motes instead cancel one point of a difficulty increase or prevent one post-roll success from being subtracted. Does not offset wound penalties, fear-based penalties, multiple-action penalties, or other non-environmental penalties; the Storyteller remains final arbiter of what qualifies.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Supplemental. Ranged Combat Charms tree (Perception-keyed); root Charm of the tree.
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Ranged Combat Charms' tree, p. 100 (PDF 101); visually cross-checked against the Ranged Combat Charms tree diagram, confirming it as the tree's root prerequisite.

name: Paramagnetic Tether Beam
summary: A finger-mounted device that projects a ray of telekinetic force, letting an Alchemical crudely manipulate, grab, disarm, or even hang and winch herself along an intangible line using raw Essence in place of Strength and Dexterity.
requirements: Minimum Strength 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Aim-Calibrating Sensors.
mechanics: Projects a single beam up to (Strength x 10) yards, lasting as long as it is consciously directed (activating a new beam cancels the old one). Substitutes Essence for both Dexterity and Strength for telekinetic manipulation, with normal Abilities still supplying finesse (feats of strength performed with the beam use Essence + Athletics to determine maximum force). Recalling a thrown weapon or grabbing a loose one is Essence + the appropriate combat Ability; disarming a foe's weapon (not usable against attuned magical weapons still held by their owners) requires Essence + Brawl or Martial Arts; seizing a disarmed weapon off the ground requires a separate Dexterity + Brawl/Martial Arts roll declared as a multiple action. Other feats include hanging suspended by the tether beam or winching oneself up along it.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Reflexive. Ranged Combat Charms tree (Strength-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Ranged Combat Charms' tree, pp. 100-101 (PDF 101-102); visually cross-checked against the Ranged Combat Charms tree diagram.

name: Essence Pulse Cannon
summary: A built-in arm-, shoulder-, palm-, or eye-mounted energy weapon firing bolts of anima-colored plasma, with by far the deepest submodule catalog of any Alchemical Charm — ten named upgrades covering stealth, accuracy, ammo reserves, piercing fire, knockback, nonlethal fire, area blasts, Essence-draining, soul-destroying annihilation, and a devastating siege mode.
requirements: Minimum Strength 4; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Aim-Calibrating Sensors.
mechanics: Arming the cannon (2 motes, an automatic action like drawing any other sheathed weapon) makes it hum and glow, displaying like an anima banner at the 4-7 mote range and interfering with stealth/disguise. Active statistics: fires with Dexterity + Archery; range (Essence x 50) yards; accuracy +1; rate (Essence x number of installations); damage 2L per mote spent powering the blast (capped at Strength + Essence motes per shot); each shot counts as a supplemental Charm use; bolts have no physical component but are dodgeable/parriable normally. Ten submodules (2 bonus points/6 xp each, freely combinable unless stated otherwise): Discreet (hidden eye/palm mount, +1 difficulty to detect while inactive, displays only at the 1-3 mote range when firing); Guidance Ray (free reflexive on/off, +3 accuracy but grants the target +1 die to dodge/parry via the visible tracer beam); Internal Battery (adds an 8-mote reserve usable only to fire this Charm; refilling costs 2 motes from the main Essence pool per simple action; only one battery permitted); Precision Beam (-2 raw damage dice but the bolt becomes piercing; incompatible with detonation or shockwave); Shockwave (damage capped at one level per hit, but knocks human-sized-or-smaller targets back one yard per die of post-soak raw damage, dealing extra collision damage and forcing a knockdown check at difficulty 2); Stunning Bolt (3B per mote instead of lethal damage; excess damage past Incapacitated does not spill over); Detonation (requires Essence 3; 1L per mote to the direct target, plus a spreading blast dealing base damage at 1 yard and losing a die per further yard; combinable with shockwave for outward knockback); Essence Dampening Bolt / Energy Drain (requires Essence 3 / Essence 4 for the Energy Drain variant; deals lethal damage plus an Essence bonus but only permanent-Essence soak applies, draining 1 mote of the target's Essence per level of damage — feeding an Exalted target's own anima banner in the base version, or refilling the Alchemical's own Essence pool in the Energy Drain variant; incompatible with shockwave, stunning bolt, precision beam, or pattern disruptor); Pattern Disruptor (requires Essence 4; 1A per mote, halves other base-damage bonuses rounded down, disintegrates whatever it kills or destroys, permanently annihilates slain spirits, and obliterates mortal souls unless the victim carries an implanted soulgem; incompatible with detonation, shockwave, or stunning bolt); Siege Devastator (requires Essence 5; reflexive on/off but a full turn to ready or stow, replacing a forearm/hand entirely, dropping rate to 1, imposing a -2 mobility penalty cumulative with armor, and displaying like an anima banner at the 8-10 mote range, in exchange for +1 raw damage die per mote regardless of other modifications used, i.e. 3L per mote unmodified).
cost: 2 motes (base activation; submodule effects layer on top per shot); Installation Cost: 1 mote.
compatibility: Duration: Indefinite. Type: Supplemental. Ranged Combat Charms tree (Strength-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Ranged Combat Charms' tree, pp. 101-103 (PDF 102-104); visually cross-checked against the Ranged Combat Charms tree diagram. This is the largest single Charm write-up encountered in this pass; flagged for future re-verification of the exact mutual-exclusion matrix among the Essence Dampening Bolt/Energy Drain and Pattern Disruptor submodules given how many combination restrictions the text lists.

name: Interceptor Spark Emitter
summary: An Essence Pulse Cannon upgrade Charm that lets an Alchemical shoot incoming missiles out of the air, either against a single tracked projectile or, in a full defensive-trance mode, against every ranged attack aimed at her that turn.
requirements: Minimum Wits 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Essence Pulse Cannon (need not be actively armed to use this Charm).
mechanics: First mode (2 motes): reflexively target and fire at a single missile within (Essence x 50) yards that the Exalt is aware of, rolling Dexterity + Archery + Essence as a parry (adding a die if using the cannon's guidance ray upgrade); defending someone else instead of himself raises the parry's difficulty by 3. A full success destroys physical missiles or dissipates energy attacks; artifact projectiles are deflected harmlessly, most mortal weapons are heat-warped to uselessness, and other extremely durable objects may qualify for protection at Storyteller discretion. Cannot target anything notably larger than a javelin unless the Alchemical is Essence 6+, which removes the size limit entirely. Second mode (3 motes, usable only if the Exalt has not yet acted that turn): a full parry against every ranged attack she perceives and wishes to block that turn, at her full Dexterity + Archery + Essence pool per attack (including defending others at +3 difficulty), but she cannot abort the trance to defend against hand-to-hand attacks or otherwise act that turn.
cost: 2 motes or 3 motes; Installation Cost: None.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Reflexive. Ranged Combat Charms tree (Wits-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Ranged Combat Charms' tree, pp. 103-104 (PDF 104-105); visually cross-checked against the Ranged Combat Charms tree diagram.

name: Pulseweb Entanglement Burst
summary: An Essence Pulse Cannon upgrade that fires a compressed net of Essence instead of a bolt, trapping a target in a crystalline aura that both restrains and lightly protects them while the Alchemical maintains the field turn after turn.
requirements: Minimum Strength 5; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Essence Pulse Cannon.
mechanics: Fired with Dexterity + Archery (no default accuracy bonus, though the cannon's guidance ray or internal battery upgrades still apply; no other cannon modification may be used); range increment (Essence x 20) yards. On hitting an animate target, an opposed Strength + Essence roll decides the outcome: if the Alchemical wins, the target is paralyzed for the rest of the turn as if held in a clinch, with the committed motes locked until the aura breaks; if the victim wins, the field shatters harmlessly. Each subsequent turn, a fresh reflexive contested Strength + Essence roll (independent of either character's action, continuing even if either is unconscious) decides whether the aura holds — dealing 1 unsoakable bashing level per turn held, stopping once the victim is Incapacitated but still restraining her — or shatters, freeing the target to act if conscious. The Alchemical may voluntarily dissipate the web at any time. The aura reduces the raw damage of any attack against the trapped victim by the Alchemical's Essence rating (potentially to zero) and inflicts the Alchemical's Essence in dice of piercing bashing damage on anyone striking the entrapped victim in hand-to-hand combat.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Simple. Ranged Combat Charms tree (Strength-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Ranged Combat Charms' tree, p. 104 (PDF 105); visually cross-checked against the Ranged Combat Charms tree diagram.

name: Protosynthetic Ammunition Replicator
summary: A forearm-mounted implant that manufactures short-lived but fully solid Essence ammunition on demand — arrows of several head types, throwing daggers, batons, or chakrams — automatically feeding a carried bow as needed.
requirements: Minimum Dexterity 2; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Aim-Calibrating Sensors.
mechanics: Each activation creates one projectile of the Exalt's choice (target, frog crotch, fowling or broadhead arrow; throwing dagger; throwing baton; or a chakram whose interlocking blades unfold into something resembling a buzz saw); arrows are automatically fed/notched into a carried bow via an internal tendril for instant firing. Manufactured ammunition is fully solid and functions normally, but dissipates back into wisps of light after a number of turns equal to the creator's Essence. Ammunition scales to the Alchemical's build, so Essence 6+ Exalted generate warstrider-scaled missiles.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Reflexive. Ranged Combat Charms tree (Dexterity-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Ranged Combat Charms' tree, pp. 104-105 (PDF 105-106); visually cross-checked against the Ranged Combat Charms tree diagram.

name: Repeating Pneumatic Bow
summary: A forearm-integrated, steam-and-Essence-powered automatic bow that draws ammunition straight from the Alchemical's Protosynthetic Ammunition Replicator, upgradeable with a targeting ray or a self-contained arrow magazine.
requirements: Minimum Strength 3; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Protosynthetic Ammunition Replicator.
mechanics: Statistics: base damage Strength (as modified by its ammunition), accuracy equal to Essence, range increment (100 x Essence) yards, unlimited rate; the weapon visibly hisses and thrums when active, making it obvious to onlookers as a dangerous magical weapon. Must draw arrows from the Ammunition Replicator's internal clip; firing the bow itself does not count as a separate Charm activation. Submodules (2 bonus points/6 xp each, freely combinable): Guidance Ray (duplicates the Essence Pulse Cannon submodule of the same name); Internal Magazine (stores up to 6 arrows generated via the Replicator inside a stasis field that halts their disintegration until they are fired that turn, letting the character feed the weapon from either the replicator or the magazine as desired).
compatibility: Duration: Indefinite. Type: Reflexive. Ranged Combat Charms tree (Strength-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Ranged Combat Charms' tree, p. 105 (PDF 106); visually cross-checked against the Ranged Combat Charms tree diagram.

name: Subluminous Onslaught Missile
summary: An upgrade to the Repeating Pneumatic Bow that fires a mile-ranged, near-unparriable spike of crystallized Essence with devastating piercing damage and a concussive shockwave that can send victims flying.
requirements: Minimum Strength 5; Minimum Essence 4; Prerequisite Charms: Repeating Pneumatic Bow.
mechanics: Fired with the Exalt's full Dexterity + Archery; accuracy equals Essence; range increment one mile; base damage [Strength + (Essence x 2)]L, piercing, and cannot be parried without a stunt or Charm. On dealing damage, the missile loses one raw-damage die and continues flying in a straight line until it fails to inflict further damage. A concussive shockwave follows the missile, knocking human-sized-or-smaller victims back one foot per die of post-soak damage; victims who strike a solid surface instead of skidding to a halt take 1B per remaining yard of travel (potentially lethal against a hazardous surface).
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Simple. Ranged Combat Charms tree (Strength-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Ranged Combat Charms' tree, p. 105 (PDF 106); visually cross-checked against the Ranged Combat Charms tree diagram.

name: Hundredfold Strafing Methodology
summary: A Repeating Pneumatic Bow upgrade that sweeps a wide arc with a continuous stream of Essence darts, striking every target — friend or foe — caught in the swath with a single attack roll.
requirements: Minimum Dexterity 5; Minimum Essence 4; Prerequisite Charms: Repeating Pneumatic Bow (must already be deployed to activate this Charm, though it generates its own ammunition independent of the Ammunition Replicator).
mechanics: The Exalt specifies an arc width up to 90 degrees and sweeps her arm across it; for the remainder of the turn, the bow fires a constant stream of darts (existing until the end of the turn) cutting through every target in the path. The player rolls Dexterity + Archery once and applies the result to every target caught in the swath. The darts have a 100-yard range increment and inflict a base lethal damage equal to Essence. Outside combat, the Charm can generally cut down large amounts of vegetation or obstacles in a single sweep.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Extra Action. Ranged Combat Charms tree (Dexterity-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Ranged Combat Charms' tree, pp. 105-106 (PDF 106-107); visually cross-checked against the Ranged Combat Charms tree diagram.

name: Transmodal Rapid Targeting System
summary: A neural-tattoo implant letting an Alchemical either bounce a single projectile through a cascading series of targets or unleash a near-simultaneous volley of separate missiles at multiple foes.
requirements: Minimum Dexterity 5; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Aim-Calibrating Sensors.
mechanics: First mode (3 motes per additional target): a single projectile is fired or thrown at an initial target, then — whether it hit or missed — the player selects a new target and rolls again at full pool for another 3 motes, repeating up to a total of (Essence + 1) attacks with no target struck twice; the Exalt may pay 1 mote at any point to recall the projectile to hand instead of leaving it lodged in the final target. All targets in a cascade must be traceable in range from the Exalt, with range penalties shifting per normal rules, and weapons with a single maximum range and no increments (such as firewands) require every target within that radius. Combining the retargeting mode with Essence Pulse Cannon in a Combo pays the Essence cost only once and carries submodule effects consistently to every target (a detonation submodule only triggers on the final hit); combining it with Repeating Pneumatic Bow requires a Combo with Protosynthetic Ammunition Replicator but only pays that Charm's cost once; it cannot be Comboed with Paramagnetic Tether Beam, Pulseweb Entanglement Burst, Subluminous Onslaught Missile, or any other Charm the Storyteller rules illogical. Second mode (same cost and rules): fires distinct missiles at superhuman speed instead of one recycled projectile, requiring separate ammunition per shot, unable to recall projectiles, and able to strike the same target multiple times; when Comboed with Essence Pulse Cannon each bolt is paid for and configured separately, and Protosynthetic Ammunition Replicator must be reactivated per shot; this volley mode may be Comboed with any Charm barred from the retargeting mode.
cost: 3 motes per target; Installation Cost: 2 motes.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Extra Action. Ranged Combat Charms tree (Dexterity-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Ranged Combat Charms' tree, pp. 106-107 (PDF 107-108); visually cross-checked against the Ranged Combat Charms tree diagram.

name: Dedicated Harmonic Targeting
summary: A sensor-lock Charm used with the Transmodal Rapid Targeting System that dematerializes a fired projectile so it ignores all cover and can never strike an unintended bystander, rematerializing only as it reaches its true target.
requirements: Minimum Perception 3; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Transmodal Rapid Targeting System.
mechanics: Locks onto a single currently-perceived target's unique Essence signature and imprints it on a fired or thrown projectile, which becomes translucent and physically ignores all intervening cover, shields, and obstacles (removing associated penalties) and cannot hit a bystander even on the worst botch. It rematerializes just before striking its intended target, so worn armor still protects normally. If the projectile fails to strike its target by the end of the turn, it either disintegrates (most objects) or teleports back to its owner's hand (attuned artifacts). May be used to snipe a target through an intervening wall, provided the Alchemical has some way to perceive the victim through the barrier.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Supplemental. Ranged Combat Charms tree (Perception-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Ranged Combat Charms' tree, p. 107 (PDF 108); visually cross-checked against the Ranged Combat Charms tree diagram.

name: Strain Resistant Chassis Modification
summary: A permanent reinforcement Charm that lets an Alchemical trade installation slots for extra health levels by adding armored plates, struts, and redundant parts to her frame.
mechanics: On installation the player chooses either two -1 health levels or three -2 health levels; the choice is locked until the Charm is reinstalled. It may be installed as many times as the Exalt's permanent Essence. Essence 6-7 Alchemicals may instead choose three -1 or four -2 health levels per installation, and Essence 8+ Alchemicals may choose four -1 or five -2 health levels per installation. Eclipse and Moonshadow Caste Exalted may not install this Charm.
requirements: Minimum Stamina 2; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: None.
compatibility: Duration: N/A. Type: Permanent. Might and Mobility Charms tree (Stamina-keyed); root of the Stamina branch.
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Might and Mobility Charms' tree, p. 107 (PDF 108); visually cross-checked against the Might and Mobility Charms I tree diagram on p. 108. Eclipse/Moonshadow exclusion is stated explicitly in the text.

name: Pain Suppression Nodes
summary: Crystalline amulets implanted in major nerve clusters that mute an Alchemical's wound penalties while leaving her fully aware of her injuries.
mechanics: While active, this Charm reduces all wound penalties by half the character's Stamina, rounded up. Alchemicals with Essence 6-7 may install a superior variant that subtracts full Stamina from all wound penalties. Essence 8+ Alchemicals need only a single installation to become completely immune to all penalties from physical pain or discomfort.
requirements: Minimum Stamina 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Sustained Augmentation of Stamina.
compatibility: Duration: Indefinite. Type: Simple. Might and Mobility Charms tree (Stamina-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Might and Mobility Charms' tree, p. 107 (PDF 108); visually cross-checked against the Might and Mobility Charms I tree diagram on p. 108.

name: Subcutaneous/Exoskeletal Armor Plating
summary: A permanent installation of dense metal plating, either hidden under the skin or riveted on as a visible carapace, that adds natural or armor-type soak stacking with any worn armor.
mechanics: Each subcutaneous installation adds +2L/+3B to natural soak and remains hidden from notice; each exoskeletal installation instead adds +3L/+4B, counts as armor, and is immediately obvious. The two modes stack with each other and with worn armor (which must be custom-fitted to the added bulk). An Alchemical may install this Charm a number of times up to her Essence, in any mix of modes. Essence 6-7 Alchemicals add +3L/+4B (subcutaneous) or +4L/+5B (exoskeletal) per installation; Essence 8+ Alchemicals add +5L/+6B/+5A per installation. Under Exalted Power Combat, Essence 6+ versions add Hardness +1L/+2B (subdermal) or +2L/+3B (exoskeletal) per installation, and Essence 8+ bulkheads have Hardness +3L/+4B/+2A per installation.
requirements: Minimum Stamina 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Sustained Augmentation of Stamina.
compatibility: Duration: N/A. Type: Permanent. Might and Mobility Charms tree (Stamina-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Might and Mobility Charms' tree, p. 108 (PDF 109); visually cross-checked against the Might and Mobility Charms I tree diagram.

name: Aegis Integration System
summary: Subdermal ports beside every major joint that mechanically lock an Alchemical's worn armor into place like a second skin, easing its mobility penalty and fatigue cost.
mechanics: Activating the Charm while wearing armor extends screws from the ports over a five-minute process, after which the armor's mobility penalty and fatigue value are each reduced by 3. Removing the armor requires reactivating the Charm and another five-minute retraction period.
requirements: Minimum Stamina 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Sustained Augmentation of Stamina.
compatibility: Duration: Five minutes. Type: Simple. Might and Mobility Charms tree (Stamina-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Might and Mobility Charms' tree, p. 108 (PDF 109); visually cross-checked against the Might and Mobility Charms I tree diagram.

name: Essence Shield Projector
summary: A skin-mounted crystal lattice that emits a glowing force field for a scene, functioning either as cumulative body armor or as a hand-mounted force disk that raises attackers' difficulty.
mechanics: Charging the field costs motes freely at 1B/1L soak per mote spent (like Essence Pulse Cannon's arming display, it negates stealth at the 8-10 mote anima level); this protection is armor-type but stacks cumulatively with any physical or Charm-granted armor the Exalt wears, up to a maximum of Stamina + Essence motes committed at once, and costs 1 Willpower the first time it is raised in a scene. Alternatively (or simultaneously), the Exalt can conjure a disk of force over the back of her hand: every 2 motes spent adds +1 to the difficulty of attacks against her, capped at +Essence total, also costing 1 Willpower the first time it is raised in a scene.
requirements: Minimum Stamina 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: None.
cost: Varies (1 mote per point of soak or per 2 difficulty points, plus 1 Willpower the first activation each scene); Installation Cost: 1 mote.
compatibility: Duration: One scene. Type: Simple. Might and Mobility Charms tree (Stamina-keyed); root of a Stamina branch.
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Might and Mobility Charms' tree, pp. 108-109 (PDF 109-110); visually cross-checked against the Might and Mobility Charms I tree diagram.

name: (Element-)Inured Frame
summary: A set of five separate Charms (one per element: Crystal, Lightning, Oil, Metal, Steam) that render an Alchemical's body highly resistant or immune to one of Autochthonia's native hazards, and each projects a small bubble that locally stabilizes reality against the Wyld.
mechanics: Each element-specific version is purchased and installed as a distinct Charm sharing the same statistics. In most cases the Exalt becomes completely immune to the named hostile condition unless it is magically empowered: Crystal-Inured Frame converts injurious contact with crystal/stone to bashing damage (ignoring hits below her natural bashing soak); Metal-Inured Frame does the same versus metal; Lightning-Inured Frame grants immunity to fire, lightning, and other energy discharges; Oil-Inured Frame grants immunity to acid and chemicals; Steam-Inured Frame grants immunity to temperature and pressure extremes. All five variants specifically defend against the magical environmental extremes at Autochthonia's poles, and each projects a two-yard radius bubble of stable reality immune to the Wyld's effects.
requirements: Minimum Stamina 4; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Sustained Augmentation of Stamina. Purchased and installed separately for each of the five elements.
compatibility: Duration: One day. Type: Simple. Might and Mobility Charms tree (Stamina-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Might and Mobility Charms' tree, p. 109 (PDF 110); visually cross-checked against the Might and Mobility Charms I tree diagram, where it appears as a single '(Element-)Inured Frame' node representing the family of five per-element Charms, matching how this inventory treats the two General Augmentation-of-Attribute Charms as single rows covering nine per-Attribute variants.

name: Insectile Locomotion Upgrade
summary: A radical surgical replacement of an Alchemical's legs with a spider-like thorax and metallic multi-leg arrangement, granting climbing/balance bonuses, claw attacks, feats-of-strength assistance, free pivoting, and faster ground speed at the cost of a point of permanent Clarity.
mechanics: The Exalt's organic legs are removed and replaced with (Essence x 2) metallic legs that must be Essence-powered to move and can be restored via Vat grafting if the Charm is removed; installing it grants 1 dot of permanent Clarity, and it cannot be hidden with an Integrated Artifact Transmogrifier. Benefits: one automatic success on climbing/balance/anti-knockback rolls; claws usable with Brawl, Martial Arts, or Melee while at least three legs stay grounded (speed +3, accuracy +1, damage +4L, defense +0; rate 3 under Exalted Power Combat) that can also clinch-pin but cannot grasp; +2 to Strength + Athletics for feats of strength using the legs; free-spinning waist for facing changes; and +25% ground speed. The legs remain dexterous enough to scuttle through passages as narrow as a humanoid lower body could use.
requirements: Minimum Dexterity 3; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Sustained Augmentation of Dexterity.
compatibility: Duration: Indefinite. Type: Simple. Might and Mobility Charms tree (Dexterity-keyed); root of the Dexterity branch.
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Might and Mobility Charms' tree, p. 109 (PDF 110); visually cross-checked against the Might and Mobility Charms II tree diagram on p. 110. Cross-references the Integrated Artifact Transmogrifier at pp. 120-121 (PDF 121-122), not yet inventoried at the time this row was written but added in this same pass.

name: Alloyed Reinforcement of Flesh
summary: A permanent metal-and-wire reinforcement of an Alchemical's skeleton and muscles that adds natural soak and doubles bonus dice/dots from temporary Strength boosts used on feats of strength.
mechanics: Installing the Charm adds +1L/+1B to natural soak. Whenever the character uses an anima power or Charm to temporarily raise her Strength and then performs a feat of strength, all bonus dice or dots from that temporary boost are doubled.
requirements: Minimum Strength 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Sustained or Transitory Augmentation of Strength.
compatibility: Duration: N/A. Type: Permanent. Might and Mobility Charms tree (Strength-keyed); root of a Strength branch.
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Might and Mobility Charms' tree, pp. 109-110 (PDF 110-111); visually cross-checked against the Might and Mobility Charms II tree diagram.

name: Personal Gravity Manipulation Apparatus
summary: Leg-mounted components that let an Alchemical redefine 'down' relative to herself (to walk on walls/ceilings) or reduce her own weight to run faster, with each mode activated and paid for separately.
mechanics: Primary mode: the Exalt controls her personal gravitational 'down,' letting her walk or run along any slope, wall, or ceiling capable of bearing her weight; the reorientation only extends a number of feet equal to her Essence from her feet, and jumping too high or being pulled away from a surface reverts her orientation to the ambient default (risking falls). Secondary mode: reduces the Exalt's weight to as low as 15% of normal; between 50-75% of normal weight movement speed rises by half, and at 50% or below speed doubles; the speed multiplier also applies to knockback distance.
requirements: Minimum Strength 2; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: None.
compatibility: Duration: One scene. Type: Simple. Might and Mobility Charms tree (Strength-keyed); root of a Strength branch.
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Might and Mobility Charms' tree, pp. 110-111 (PDF 111-112); visually cross-checked against the Might and Mobility Charms II tree diagram.

name: Parabolic Leap Overcharger Device
summary: An upgrade to the Personal Gravity Manipulation Apparatus, mounted behind the knees, that lets an Alchemical either levitate under sustained control or catapult herself in a single spectacular leap.
mechanics: Levitation mode (2 motes per turn of effect, purchased in advance): the character moves up to her Strength in yards vertically and (Strength x 2) yards horizontally per turn while ignoring gravity, may act normally in midair, and falls if she fails to renew the effect before it lapses; the Charm can also be activated immediately before impact to safely arrest a fall from any height. Leap mode (1 mote, instant, once per turn): a crouch-and-spring leap covering up to (Strength x Essence) yards vertically and five times that horizontally, allowing an attack in the same turn with no special bonus beyond surprise. A common combo is leaping with the secondary mode, then activating the primary mode mid-jump to begin hovering.
requirements: Minimum Strength 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Personal Gravity Manipulation Apparatus.
cost: 2 motes per turn or 1 mote; Installation Cost: None.
compatibility: Duration: Varies. Type: Reflexive. Might and Mobility Charms tree (Strength-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Might and Mobility Charms' tree, p. 111 (PDF 112); visually cross-checked against the Might and Mobility Charms II tree diagram.

name: Plasma Thruster Assembly
summary: Shielded foot- or back-mounted nozzles that propel an Alchemical on jets of glowing force, usable for a rapid burst of movement, a thruster-assisted melee strike, or sustained long-distance flight.
mechanics: Basic burst (2 motes, once per turn): travel up to (Strength x 50) yards in a straight line as a single movement. Combat thrust (4 motes, 1 Willpower): aim a burst to reach and strike a target up to (Strength x 30) yards away in melee, doubling the raw damage of a single Brawl/Martial Arts/Melee attack and forcing knockdown/knockback unless the victim succeeds at a reflexive Dexterity + Athletics roll (difficulty 2) on a hit. Sustained flight (10 motes/hour): travel at (Strength x 15) mph, as slow as (Strength x 10) mph, requiring Dexterity + Athletics rolls for maneuvers (a botch causes a crash inflicting at least 15L and stalls the Charm for an hour); the character cannot fight or take other complex actions while flying without crashing. Any mode also burns everything one yard beneath/behind the Exalt for 5L and can ignite flammables; it functions underwater but leaves a trackable steam/pressure wake for miles.
requirements: Minimum Strength 4; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Parabolic Leap Overcharger Device.
cost: 2 motes, or 4 motes plus 1 Willpower, or 10 motes/hour; Installation Cost: 1 mote.
compatibility: Duration: Instant or one hour. Type: Reflexive. Might and Mobility Charms tree (Strength-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Might and Mobility Charms' tree, pp. 111-112 (PDF 112-113); visually cross-checked against the Might and Mobility Charms II tree diagram.

name: Fluidic Impeller Drive
summary: Retractable jet modules that give an Alchemical neutral buoyancy and normal running-speed swimming, letting her act without penalty underwater or in fluids as viscous as heavy oil.
mechanics: While active, the Exalt has neutral buoyancy regardless of actual weight or fluid density, can swim at her normal running speed, and suffers no penalty for acting underwater or in fluids up to the viscosity of heavy oil.
requirements: Minimum Strength 2; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: None.
compatibility: Duration: One day. Type: Simple. Might and Mobility Charms tree (Strength-keyed); root of a Strength branch.
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Might and Mobility Charms' tree, p. 112 (PDF 113); visually cross-checked against the Might and Mobility Charms II tree diagram.

name: Electroneural Control Spurs
summary: Retractable forearm/calf tendrils that plug into a mount, vehicle, or warstrider the Exalt could otherwise direct with Ride or Sail, taming living steeds, tightening piloting bonds, and resisting forcible dismount.
mechanics: Bonding with a living creature costs it one unsoakable bashing level and reduces its control rating by the Exalt's Charisma (to zero, no rolls are needed to control it under stress); the Exalt adds her permanent Essence to Ride, cannot be forcibly dismounted short of killing the steed, and must actively withdraw the spurs (or risk being crushed/dragged) if the steed rolls or founders. Bonding with an artificial mount plugs in through ports/cracks instead of wounding it; most artificial steeds lack a control rating, though any that do reduce as above; the same Ride bonus and unbreakable tether apply, removing the need for straps/harnesses on small vehicles. Bonding to fit inside a warstrider lets a small-enough Alchemical strap in and attune with one turn of concentration instead of five minutes, reduces attunement cost by 5 motes, and reduces the armor's mobility penalty and fatigue value by the Exalt's Essence.
requirements: Minimum Charisma 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Transitory or Sustained Augmentation of Charisma.
compatibility: Duration: Indefinite. Type: Simple. Might and Mobility Charms tree (Charisma-keyed); root of the Charisma branch.
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Might and Mobility Charms' tree, pp. 112-113 (PDF 113-114); visually cross-checked against the Might and Mobility Charms II tree diagram. Text notes living mounts are not native to Autochthonia but that this Charm's technology still integrates with Creation's beasts; also cross-references warstrider rules to the Savant and Sorcerer sourcebook, out of scope.

name: Universal Pilot Key
summary: An upgrade to Electroneural Control Spurs letting an Alchemical plug directly into a large Essence-powered vessel (requiring the Sail Ability) and pilot it telepathically as an extension of her own body, sensing through its hull.
mechanics: Only works on Essence-driven craft (not purely mechanical Second Age Creation ships). While bonded, the Exalt's body falls nearly catatonic (still able to perceive/speak with difficulty) while she telepathically operates doors, lighting, speakers, and similar minor systems (up to Wits actions per turn without spending dice actions), reduces the vessel's Essence-commitment requirement by 10 motes, adds her Essence to all Sail rolls, and can see from any single vantage point within or facing out of the hull (only one viewpoint at a time). Cannot bond with vessels wider than (Charisma x 20) yards on their widest dimension; oversized craft (e.g., long pneumatic trains) can be split among a crew of bonded Alchemicals with one designated captain who holds primary interface and can reflexively veto other crew commands.
requirements: Minimum Charisma 4; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Electroneural Control Spurs.
compatibility: Duration: Indefinite. Type: Simple. Might and Mobility Charms tree (Charisma-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Might and Mobility Charms' tree, p. 113 (PDF 114); visually cross-checked against the Might and Mobility Charms II tree diagram. This Charm completes the Might and Mobility tree (14 Charms across both diagrams, treating the five (Element-)Inured Frame variants as one row).

name: Pattern Facilitation Module
summary: An implanted brain gland that releases a probability-distorting Essence pulse to sway an entire organization toward a policy it is already considering, working best on the least resolute members first.
mechanics: The Exalt must designate a policy an existing organization is currently considering (even if opposed by most members), with at least one member present (or the Exalt herself a member) when the Charm activates. Members with permanent Willpower less than the Exalt's Essence immediately favor and vocally promote the agenda; those with Willpower up to twice the Exalt's Essence feel predisposed but persuadable either way; those above that are unswayed but will still consider it fairly. Beings with Essence 2+ are immune. If more valid targets exist than (Charisma x 20), the Charm affects that many, starting from the lowest Willpower upward. Repeated use extends the effect to new targets. The enchantment lasts until the organization's leadership formally endorses or rejects the policy or the Exalt withdraws committed Essence; a later rejection is possible if the agenda proves harmful. Works best targeted at as narrow a subset of a group as possible.
requirements: Minimum Charisma 4; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Both Transitory and Sustained Augmentation of Charisma.
compatibility: Duration: Indefinite. Type: Simple. Social Charms tree (Charisma-keyed); root of a Charisma branch.
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Social Charms' tree, pp. 113-114 (PDF 114-115); visually cross-checked against the Social Charms I tree diagram on p. 114.

name: Synergy-Promoting Upgrade
summary: An orichalcum-and-jade chest implant that lets an Alchemical spur any number of aware targets (including herself) toward a single defined task, granting each a bonus specialty die on a relevant roll that turn.
mechanics: The Exalt specifies a single task achievable by the end of the turn and pays 1 mote per target she is aware of (herself included). Each targeted player may add one die, as a natural-specialty-style bonus subject to the usual specialty maximums, to one roll that furthers the task during the turn. The Storyteller is the final arbiter of whether a task is short/defined enough and whether a given roll sufficiently furthers it.
requirements: Minimum Charisma 2; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: None.
cost: 1 mote per target; Installation Cost: 1 mote.
compatibility: Duration: One turn. Type: Reflexive. Social Charms tree (Charisma-keyed); root of a Charisma branch.
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Social Charms' tree, p. 114 (PDF 115); visually cross-checked against the Social Charms I tree diagram.

name: Perfection of Assembly
summary: An expansion of the Synergy-Promoting Upgrade letting multiple Alchemicals form a telepathic hive-mind 'Assembly,' sensing each other's direction/distance/health and communicating projectively over range.
mechanics: Forming an Assembly requires at least two Alchemicals with this Charm to activate it in each other's presence; further members may join if all current members are present and willing. A character may belong to no more Assemblies than her permanent Essence, and no cluster may exceed the highest Charisma + Essence total among its members. Benefits: constant awareness of fellow members' direction and distance; a simple action to check a member's remaining health levels; reflexive telepathic communication within (Essence x 10) yards, relayable through a mutually-in-range third member to reach an out-of-range member (both relay and final target hear the message); broadcasts may be selectively targeted. The telepathy is projective only (no mind-reading), and anti-scrying wards block it like any other scrying.
requirements: Minimum Charisma 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Synergy-Promoting Upgrade.
compatibility: Duration: Indefinite. Type: Simple. Social Charms tree (Charisma-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Social Charms' tree, p. 115 (PDF 116); visually cross-checked against the Social Charms I tree diagram.

name: Thousandfold Courtesan Calculations
summary: A stored database of seduction and sensual technique that makes an Alchemical an object of overwhelming desire for a scene, boosting seduction rolls and, if consummated, leaving lower-Essence partners suggestible and mortals dangerously addicted.
mechanics: For the scene, all seduction rolls add automatic successes equal to (the Alchemical's Essence minus the target's Essence); targets of equal/greater Essence are unaffected. During consummation, roll Appearance + Performance (standard difficulty, plus the same automatic successes); if successes exceed the partner's Willpower, he becomes highly suggestible, adding the Exalt's Essence to the difficulty of Social/Wits/Willpower/Virtue rolls made to resist her, decreasing by one every full hour. Mortal partners must roll Temperance (difficulty 2): failure creates a compulsion to obtain another encounter by any non-harmful means, a botch removes even that restraint, and success leaves the mortal unaddicted (if addled for hours). If Performance successes exceed the partner's Temperance instead of Willpower, the difficulty increase starts at half Essence (rounded up) with no addiction risk; successes at or below Temperance produce only a pleasurable experience with no further effect.
requirements: Minimum Appearance 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Transitory or Sustained Augmentation of Appearance.
compatibility: Duration: One scene. Type: Simple. Social Charms tree (Appearance-keyed); root of an Appearance branch.
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Social Charms' tree, p. 115 (PDF 116); visually cross-checked against the Social Charms I tree diagram.

name: Emotive Aesthetics of the Body Electric
summary: A permanent full-body calibration letting an Alchemical apply Social rolls (seduction, intimidation, drawing attention, making friends, or 'poisoning the waters' against a rival) without speaking or otherwise acting, provided the target can perceive her.
mechanics: Cannot communicate complex thoughts or make an eloquent argument, but can seduce, intimidate, attract attention, befriend, or convey overwhelming disdain toward a present rival purely through calibrated body language. Rolls cannot use more Social Attribute dice than the character's permanent Appearance rating. Effects are extremely subtle, requiring an observer's reflexive Perception + Socialize roll (difficulty equal to the Exalt's Essence) to even notice the manipulation; a target of the feat gets this roll immediately, and bystanders only get it if they were directly and deliberately observing the Exalt at the time.
requirements: Minimum Appearance 4; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Sustained Augmentation of Appearance.
compatibility: Duration: N/A. Type: Permanent. Social Charms tree (Appearance-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Social Charms' tree, pp. 115-116 (PDF 116-117); visually cross-checked against the Social Charms I tree diagram. This Charm completes the eight-Charm Social Charms I sub-tree.

name: Empathy Simulation Engine
summary: A painfully-installed neck-and-skull implant that temporarily masks an Alchemical's Clarity for social purposes, easing interaction with mortals at the cost of a point of gained Clarity for faking emotion instead of embracing humanity.
mechanics: For the rest of the scene after activation, the character reduces her effective Clarity by her Manipulation rating for determining Social penalties, but forfeits any Compassion roll to reduce Clarity from interacting with mortals during that scene. When the duration lapses, full Clarity penalties return, and the Exalt gains 1 point of (temporary, per-use) Clarity for simulating rather than embracing empathy.
requirements: Minimum Manipulation 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: None.
compatibility: Duration: One scene. Type: Simple. Social Charms tree (Manipulation-keyed); root of the Manipulation branch.
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Social Charms' tree, p. 116 (PDF 117); visually cross-checked against the Social Charms II tree diagram on p. 117.

name: Transcendent Brutality Programming
summary: The inverse of the Empathy Simulation Engine: a permanent Charm that channels an Alchemical's cold Clarity-driven detachment into a bonus for intimidation and interrogation, at the cost of a point of permanent Clarity.
mechanics: Adds bonus dice equal to (Clarity divided by 2, rounded up) to all intimidation or interrogation-based Social rolls, treated as a specialty cumulative with other specialties. The bonus is temporarily forfeited whenever the character masks her Clarity via Empathy Simulation Engine. Installing this Charm grants 1 dot of permanent Clarity.
requirements: Minimum Manipulation 4; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Empathy Simulation Engine.
compatibility: Duration: N/A. Type: Permanent. Social Charms tree (Manipulation-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Social Charms' tree, p. 116 (PDF 117); visually cross-checked against the Social Charms II tree diagram.

name: Conceptual Entropy Module
summary: The adversarial mirror of Pattern Facilitation Module: a brain implant that turns an organization against a plan it is considering rather than promoting one, with the two Charms canceling each other when used against the same agenda.
mechanics: Uses the same target/range/duration rules as Pattern Facilitation Module, but the Exalt can only attack an existing plan under consideration, never endorse an alternative. Members fully swept up (Willpower less than the Exalt's Essence) come to hate the agenda and will use force or violence to oppose it; those with Willpower up to (Essence + 2) dislike it but can be argued into it with sufficient evidence; those above that find it distasteful but will pursue it if clearly in their interest. If used to oppose an agenda already boosted by an activation of Pattern Facilitation Module, the Exalt with the higher Essence wins outright (a tie cancels both, leaving no change).
requirements: Minimum Manipulation 3; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Transitory or Sustained Augmentation of Manipulation.
compatibility: Duration: Indefinite. Type: Simple. Social Charms tree (Manipulation-keyed); root of a Manipulation branch.
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Social Charms' tree, p. 117 (PDF 118); visually cross-checked against the Social Charms II tree diagram.

name: Motivational Vocoder
summary: A throat-anchored half-torc that lets an Alchemical impel a present group toward a single assigned task for a day, at the cost of accumulating Willpower-recovery penalties on anyone who benefits from the bonus.
mechanics: All addressed targets must be present and have permanent Essence below 2; the Exalt cannot affect more targets in one activation than (Manipulation x 10). For the rest of the day, every target adds one artificial-specialty bonus die to any action directly furthering the assigned task. At day's end, each character who used the bonus loses 1 point of Willpower and adds 1 to the difficulty of his next Conviction roll to regain Willpower, cumulative on further days up to a cap of the target's Conviction rating (at which point rest cannot restore Willpower); the penalty decreases by one die for every full day the target goes unenchanted. Targets reduced to zero temporary Willpower become listless, losing one die from all non-reflexive actions unless acting in accordance with a standing directive.
requirements: Minimum Manipulation 3; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Transitory or Sustained Augmentation of Manipulation.
compatibility: Duration: One day. Type: Simple. Social Charms tree (Manipulation-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Social Charms' tree, pp. 116-117 (PDF 117-118); visually cross-checked against the Social Charms II tree diagram.

name: Personality Override Spike
summary: A retractable foot-long stiletto-like spike that, on breaking a pierced victim's will through a nightly-repeated Essence contest, lets the Alchemical rewrite the victim's Virtues, Nature, Willpower, or memories, or knock her out or kill her outright.
mechanics: The spike is a reflexively deployable weapon (piercing damage, short-sword statistics) but its main use is mind control: piercing a sentient being of equal or lower permanent Essence and dealing any damage (or inserting it carefully with no damage if unresisting) lets the Exalt spend 8 motes and 1 Willpower to activate the Charm, paralyzing both parties for the rest of the turn. Starting the next turn, an opposed Essence + Willpower roll repeats every turn until the victim wins (both wake, spike slides free) or the Exalt accrues 3 net successes and conquers the victim's mind (no roll needed if the victim doesn't resist). Once conquered, each full turn maintaining the link lets the Exalt inflict one simple-action effect per turn: raise/lower a Virtue by a dot; change Nature; raise/lower permanent Willpower by a dot; erase a contiguous memory span (up to 5 years per turn, without the Exalt knowing what was erased); render the victim unconscious for the scene; or, for Essence-1 mortals/non-magical beings only, kill her outright. Mortal changes are permanent barring further magic or major life events (gained dots fade at one per week); Exalted and other magical beings heal one dot of a diminished Trait per day and restore Nature after another day, with memories requiring prompting and a Willpower roll (difficulty 1-5) to resurface once remembered thereafter automatically. Forcibly separating the pair (Strength + Athletics, difficulty 2) tears the filaments free, dealing the victim 3 unsoakable-except-by-natural-soak lethal levels.
requirements: Minimum Manipulation 5; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Motivational Vocoder.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Reflexive. Social Charms tree (Manipulation-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Social Charms' tree, pp. 117-119 (PDF 118-120); visually cross-checked against the Social Charms II tree diagram. Victims reduced to 0 permanent Willpower are noted as used for slave labor in Autochthonia.

name: Mind-Ripping Probe
summary: A permanent upgrade letting a Personality Override Spike also read a broken victim's memories, either answering a specific question through involuntary vignettes or scanning for falsified/deleted memories.
mechanics: Requires the victim's will to already be broken per Personality Override Spike. As a simple action, the Exalt may either: ask one question about the victim's past, which the victim involuntarily answers via memory vignettes selected by her own player (with the Storyteller able to demand more detail for vague answers to straightforward questions); or roll Wits + Awareness (standard difficulty, ignoring successes beyond the Exalt's own Essence) to detect all falsehoods/deletions created by beings of permanent Essence equal to or less than the successes rolled, without learning the underlying truth unless later reversed via Memory Implantation Surge.
requirements: Minimum Manipulation 5; Minimum Essence 4; Prerequisite Charms: Personality Override Spike.
compatibility: Duration: N/A. Type: Permanent. Social Charms tree (Manipulation-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Social Charms' tree, p. 119 (PDF 120); visually cross-checked against the Social Charms II tree diagram.

name: Memory Implantation Surge
summary: A further Personality Override Spike upgrade that inserts false memories into a mind-broken victim, scaled from a small lie to a total life rewrite, and can also excise a prior falsehood or deletion once its presence is known.
mechanics: As a simple action against a will-broken victim, roll Manipulation + (Performance, Presence, or Lore, whichever is highest) against a difficulty equal to the target's Essence. Successes determine scope: one success permits a superficial change; two allow gross changes that may not mesh with memory continuity (contradictory evidence lets the victim reconstruct the truth while still recalling the false version); three permit one sweeping change that always feels real even if evidence disproves it; four allow a full rewrite of up to five years with arbitrary detail; five allow rewriting a victim's entire life in full detail. Mortals do not naturally recover true memories (though very strong-willed ones, Willpower 7+, may have confusing dreams); magical beings can challenge a known-false memory with a Willpower roll (difficulty = the Exalt's Essence), reinforcing the falsehood on a botch or restoring the truth on success. The Charm can also remove a known-damaged (programmed-false or erased) memory segment, restoring the truth completely, once the Alchemical is certain the area is damaged (via Mind-Ripping Probe or independent evidence).
requirements: Minimum Manipulation 5; Minimum Essence 4; Prerequisite Charms: Mind-Ripping Probe.
compatibility: Duration: N/A. Type: Permanent. Social Charms tree (Manipulation-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Social Charms' tree, p. 119 (PDF 120); visually cross-checked against the Social Charms II tree diagram. This Charm completes the seven-Charm Social Charms II sub-tree.

name: Identifying Charms (sidebar rule)
summary: A general Chapter Three sidebar rule (not a Charm) explaining how observers can visually or magically deduce what an installed Alchemical Charm does, scaled by successes on an Intelligence + Occult roll.
mechanics: An observer rolls Intelligence + Occult at a difficulty equal to the scrutinized Charm's minimum Essence rating. One success reveals whether the device is offensive, defensive, or neither; three successes reveal a general idea of its primary function; five successes reveal its exact workings. Alchemicals automatically recognize any Charm they have personally had installed, without a roll. Observers unfamiliar with Autochthonian technology (such as most people in Creation) add 1 to the difficulty until they gain enough exposure to Alchemicals to begin recognizing Charm designs.
compatibility: Applies to any physically visible, installed Alchemical Charm being scrutinized by an observer.
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Identifying Charms' sidebar, p. 119 (PDF 120), positioned between the Social Charms and Stealth and Disguise Charms trees.

name: Integrated Artifact Transmogrifier
summary: A flesh-and-mechanism system that physically retracts and hides an Alchemical's other visible Charms, and can also let Essence 2-5 Alchemicals disguise themselves as fully human for a Willpower-fueled day.
mechanics: Costs 1 mote per Charm hidden or 5 motes to hide as many as desired at once; suppressing a Charm normally deactivates it (only permanent-type Charms may keep functioning while hidden, Storyteller discretion), frees any activation-cost Essence but not installation Essence, and reactivating any hidden Charm (a reflexive, non-Charm-activation action for dormant permanents) reveals it and, if hidden via the 5-mote option, reveals every concurrently hidden Charm at once. Hidden Charms resist Essence sight/detection unless the observer's permanent Essence exceeds the Alchemical's by two or more dots; Charms with no visible outward form need not be hidden unless concealing them from Essence sight specifically. Essence 2-5 Alchemicals may additionally suppress all visible Charms and spend 1 Willpower to vivify their flesh into a fully convincing human semblance (Essence 4-5 remain oversized, drawing attention regardless; Essence 6+ cannot pass as human at all); this disguise makes the Exalt bleed like a mortal, lasts one day before requiring renewal, allows retracting or reconfiguring the visible soulgem, and is broken (until re-suppressed) by using any hidden Charm. This Charm may be placed in a Combo despite its non-instant duration.
requirements: Minimum Appearance 1; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: None.
cost: 1 mote per Charm or 5 motes; Installation Cost: 1 mote.
compatibility: Duration: Indefinite. Type: Reflexive. Stealth and Disguise Charms tree (Appearance-keyed); root of the tree.
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Stealth and Disguise Charms' tree, pp. 120-121 (PDF 121-122); visually cross-checked against the Stealth and Disguise Charms tree diagram on p. 120.

name: Essence Dormancy Mode
summary: An upgrade to the Integrated Artifact Transmogrifier that shields an Alchemical's true nature from Essence sight by voluntarily dampening her own permanent Essence rating, shutting down inaccessible or active Charms in the process.
mechanics: On activation, the Exalt lowers her permanent Essence by as many dots as desired (minimum 1) for as long as the Charm remains committed; this does not reduce her size. She cannot access or activate Charms requiring a higher minimum Essence than her dampened rating, and active Charm effects (including permanent-type ones) shut down, though committed Essence sustaining them remains committed. Only disguise-based Charms (Integrated Artifact Transmogrifier, Voice Distortion Field), a Biofunction Inhibitor, a Biostasis Field Projector, and/or this Charm itself are exempt, allowing the character to still masquerade as human or as a dead human. Reducing to Essence 1 fully shuts down Essence pools/anima and hides the character from magic that detects latent Essence. Reflexively ending commitment restores everything, including the anima's prior level before it resumes fading normally. May be placed in a Combo despite its non-instant duration.
requirements: Minimum Appearance 2; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Integrated Artifact Transmogrifier.
compatibility: Duration: Indefinite. Type: Reflexive. Stealth and Disguise Charms tree (Appearance-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Stealth and Disguise Charms' tree, p. 121 (PDF 122); visually cross-checked against the Stealth and Disguise Charms tree diagram. Cross-references Biofunction Inhibitor (p. 130/PDF 131) and Biostasis Field Projector (p. 134/PDF 135), both inventoried in this same pass under Medical Charms.

name: Husk-Sculpting Apparatus
summary: Wire-hook-and-pigment-injector implants that let an Alchemical reshape her own cosmetic appearance in real detail (height, build, coloration, scars/tattoos, and even gender) with changes that persist until deliberately altered again.
mechanics: Cannot exactly duplicate a specific person, but can approximate someone's build/coloration for +3 dice on mundane impersonation. Roll Appearance + Craft (Body) at standard difficulty each activation; successes determine how many separate cosmetic changes (Storyteller's call on what counts as separate) may be made, including height shifts up to six inches, full pigmentation/texture changes, added or removed scars/tattoos, altered musculature, and (Essence 3+) a full gender swap or genderless/hermaphroditic body (genderless bodies are immune to seduction; sterility already applies to all Alchemicals). Temporary Appearance from a recalibrated visage can range from 0 (freakish/terrifying, +2 dice to intimidation) to the character's permanent rating, though Charm prerequisites always use permanent Appearance. A botch shifts the character to Appearance 0 for a day and locks out reuse during that time. Changes are permanent until altered again; the character cannot change fundamental shape, add/remove limbs, hide implanted Charms, or otherwise leave the humanoid template. Can be paired with Integrated Artifact Transmogrifier to fake convincing (even bleeding) wounds.
requirements: Minimum Appearance 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Integrated Artifact Transmogrifier.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Simple. Stealth and Disguise Charms tree (Appearance-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Stealth and Disguise Charms' tree, pp. 121-122 (PDF 122-123); visually cross-checked against the Stealth and Disguise Charms tree diagram.

name: Voice Distortion Field
summary: A throat rivet and voicebox wiring that lets an Alchemical mimic voices/sounds, layer subliminal emotional tones into her speech, or dramatically amplify her volume.
mechanics: Impersonation: Manipulation + Performance roll (difficulty 2 for a regular associate's voice, 4 if only heard in passing) makes the Exalt's voice indistinguishable from the target's for as long as Essence is committed (no roll needed for a generic anonymous voice); the same roll difficulty scheme lets her mimic any heard sound, even ones no human voice could naturally produce, with entire auditory memories replayable after a Wits + Awareness recall roll (difficulty 1-5) plus the Manipulation + Performance roll; mimicry/playback costs 1 mote per sound cluster and may be replayed indefinitely once paid for. Emotional tone: 1 mote to layer one chosen emotion (overt or subliminal) into her voice, granting +1 die (as a specialty) whenever a Social roll evoking that voiced emotion is made, lasting as long as Essence is committed; only one emotion may be set at a time. Volume: 1 mote lets her be clearly heard out to (Manipulation x 100) yards for a turn, uncomfortably loud up close but not deafening; combinable with the other two modes to broadcast tones or recordings to a crowd.
requirements: Minimum Manipulation 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: None.
compatibility: Duration: Varies. Type: Reflexive. Stealth and Disguise Charms tree (Manipulation-keyed); root of a Manipulation branch.
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Stealth and Disguise Charms' tree, p. 122 (PDF 123); visually cross-checked against the Stealth and Disguise Charms tree diagram.

name: Pheromone Regulation Systems
summary: Subdermal micro-pumps and glands that let an Alchemical either exude a psychoactive fragrance boosting a targeted emotional Social roll or mask all scent to defeat tracking.
mechanics: Emotional mode: adds one specialty-style die to Social rolls that resonate with the projected emotion (e.g. a lust scent aiding seduction) against targets within the Exalt's Charisma in yards; only the most wary observers can detect the chemical (Perception + Awareness, difficulty 6) without superhuman senses. Masking mode: makes the character untrackable by mundane scent and raises the difficulty of supernatural scent-tracking by her permanent Essence. Only one mode (a single pheromone cocktail, or masking) may run at a time, never both.
requirements: Minimum Charisma 2; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: None.
compatibility: Duration: Indefinite. Type: Simple. Stealth and Disguise Charms tree (Charisma-keyed); root of the tree.
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Stealth and Disguise Charms' tree, pp. 122-123 (PDF 123-124); visually cross-checked against the Stealth and Disguise Charms tree diagram.

name: Optical Shroud
summary: A skin-embedded crystal lattice that renders an Alchemical invisible while she stays still, betrayed only by a faint air distortion, though it cannot fool direct Essence sight and any real movement shatters it.
mechanics: Spotting the mirage requires Perception + Awareness (standard difficulty if the observer saw the character vanish, 4 if alert/suspicious, 5 otherwise). Concealment persists as long as the Exalt stays still (minor actions like drawing a weapon or turning to look are fine, but moving location or making quick movements such as most attacks breaks it). Anyone attacking or defending against an invisible character still subtracts two successes as normal, even if the attack itself breaks the camouflage. Provides no concealment from direct Essence sight, but does block Measure the Wind and similar location-pinpointing spirit magic (such Charms only reveal a nearby Essence source, maskable amid other visible sources).
requirements: Minimum Appearance 2; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: None.
compatibility: Duration: Indefinite. Type: Reflexive. Stealth and Disguise Charms tree (Appearance-keyed); root of an Appearance branch.
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Stealth and Disguise Charms' tree, p. 123 (PDF 124); visually cross-checked against the Stealth and Disguise Charms tree diagram.

name: Aura-Dampening Component
summary: A permanent Optical Shroud upgrade using white-jade baffles to let an Alchemical spend Peripheral Essence on disguise/anima effects without it registering as Peripheral, easing her limited Personal Essence budget.
mechanics: With this Charm installed, the character may spend an additional mote when using any Transitory Augmentation of (Attribute) Charm, an anima power, or a disguise/concealment Charm; all Peripheral Essence spent powering such an effect is thereafter treated as Personal Essence, preventing the expenditure from revealing the Exalt's nature.
requirements: Minimum Appearance 2; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Optical Shroud.
compatibility: Duration: N/A. Type: Permanent. Stealth and Disguise Charms tree (Appearance-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Stealth and Disguise Charms' tree, p. 123 (PDF 124); visually cross-checked against the Stealth and Disguise Charms tree diagram.

name: Dynamic Cloaking Module
summary: An adaptive-camouflage upgrade to Optical Shroud that lets an Alchemical stay concealed while moving, appearing only as a faint heat-wave-like distortion.
mechanics: Spotting the Exalt requires Perception + Awareness at a difficulty equal to her permanent Essence if she moved significantly on the current or prior turn (also the difficulty on the activation turn), rising by 2 if she instead holds nearly motionless for a full turn. Attackers/defenders against the invisible character still subtract two successes as normal; ranged attackers additionally subtract the Exalt's Essence in successes, and opponents with only normal human senses cannot even target her beyond 100 yards without an appropriate Charm or an exceptional (three-die) stunt. As with Optical Shroud, this provides no protection from direct Essence sight and blocks only location-pinpointing magic like Measure the Wind, not detection of a nearby Essence source in general.
requirements: Minimum Appearance 2; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Optical Shroud.
compatibility: Duration: One hour. Type: Simple. Stealth and Disguise Charms tree (Appearance-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Stealth and Disguise Charms' tree, p. 123 (PDF 124); visually cross-checked against the Stealth and Disguise Charms tree diagram.

name: Essence Veil
summary: A permanent capstone upgrade making an Alchemical's Optical Shroud and Dynamic Cloaking Module equally effective against Essence sight/magical detection as against normal vision, while also muffling sound.
mechanics: When using either the Optical Shroud or the Dynamic Cloaking Module, the Exalt becomes just as difficult to detect via Essence sight and other magical detection as she is visually. As an added benefit, the dampening field also quiets sound while either Charm is engaged, increasing the difficulty to notice the Exalt by auditory means by her Essence rating.
requirements: Minimum Appearance 2; Minimum Essence 4; Prerequisite Charms: Dynamic Cloaking Module.
compatibility: Duration: N/A. Type: Permanent. Stealth and Disguise Charms tree (Appearance-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Stealth and Disguise Charms' tree, pp. 123-124 (PDF 124-125); visually cross-checked against the Stealth and Disguise Charms tree diagram. This Charm completes the nine-Charm Stealth and Disguise Charms tree.

name: Optical Enhancement
summary: A base eye-implant Charm awarding two of seven ocular submodules on installation, with further ones purchasable individually: Flash Shutters, Light-Intensification Filters, Microscopic Lens, Telescopic Lens, Ultraperipheral Awareness, Thermal Vision, and Mass-Penetrating Scan.
mechanics: On purchase, the player selects two of the seven listed modifications; each additional one costs 3 bonus points or 6 experience points and an hour of Vat refit (new modifications may be designed with Storyteller approval). Flash Shutters: semiopaque lids auto-block visual overstimulation (including close heat sources if Thermal Vision is also installed). Light-Intensification Filters: negate all penalties short of absolute darkness, but inflict bright-light penalties (as murky vision, plus -1 to wound penalties from pain) unless Flash Shutters is also installed; the reflective sheen can be spotted in dim light (Perception + Awareness, difficulty 4). Microscopic Lens: diceless magnification up to (Perception x 10), narratively resolved. Telescopic Lens: diceless magnification up to (Perception x 25) with a matching reduction in peripheral vision; cannot be used simultaneously with the microscopic lens. Ultraperipheral Awareness: 360-degree vision via head-ringed receptors, granting a reflexive Perception + Awareness roll (standard difficulty) to notice rear/ambush attacks the field of vision could see (not invisible/hidden attackers), though a shield still needs time to reposition to protect the rear. Thermal Vision: reflexive switch (3 motes, no separate Charm activation) trading color/detail vision for heat-sight, gauging temperature (Perception + Awareness) and navigating in darkness at (Perception x 10) yards clear / (Perception x 20) yards murky vision, spotting flames for Essence miles with line of sight, highlighting warm bodies (+1 die as a specialty to notice/attack them), suffering murky-vision penalties near intense heat and blindness within two yards of it; requires Essence 3. Mass-Penetrating Scan: reflexive 3-mote activation (counts as a Charm use) letting the Exalt see through solid matter for a turn within a one-yard-wide tunnel of vision (no peripheral awareness), panning via Perception + Awareness rolls to find things of note; requires Essence 4.
requirements: Minimum Perception 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Transitory or Sustained Augmentation of Perception.
compatibility: Duration: N/A. Type: Permanent. Sensory and Spiritual Charms tree (Perception-keyed); root of a Perception branch.
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Sensory and Spiritual Charms' tree, pp. 124-125 (PDF 125-126); visually cross-checked against the Sensory and Spiritual Charms I tree diagram on p. 124. The seven submodules are summarized rather than reproduced in full narrative color, matching how this inventory summarizes the largest multi-submodule Charms (e.g. Essence Pulse Cannon).

name: Chemical Analysis System
summary: Nostril and tongue implants extending an Alchemical's taste and smell to superhuman range and sensitivity, resolved mostly through Storyteller narration.
mechanics: For the duration, the character is assumed to detect trace chemicals (acid, iron, poison in food, faint pheromones, etc.) that others cannot; sensitivity is roughly (Perception x 10) times normal for detection range/concentration. The text explicitly frames this as a narrative rather than exact-science Charm, with Storytellers generally assuming the character smells/tastes everything present absent a compelling reason otherwise.
requirements: Minimum Perception 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Transitory or Sustained Augmentation of Perception.
compatibility: Duration: One hour. Type: Simple. Sensory and Spiritual Charms tree (Perception-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Sensory and Spiritual Charms' tree, p. 127 (PDF 128); visually cross-checked against the Sensory and Spiritual Charms I tree diagram.

name: Tympanal Receptor Upgrade
summary: Cochlear implants extending an Alchemical's hearing to ultrasonic/subsonic ranges and adding a large sound-based Perception bonus, while also protecting against deafness.
mechanics: Mostly a narrative sensory enhancement (detecting ultrasound/subsound, fine pitch discrimination), but mechanically the character adds her permanent Essence to all sound-based Perception rolls (including most ambush checks) as an artificial specialty that may exceed +3 but does not stack with other applicable specialties. Grants the low-light-vision-only penalty while blind (rather than full blindness penalties) due to heightened spatial hearing, without granting any actual visual/color capability. The Charm's filters prevent deafness from heightened sensitivity but cannot counter deliberate hyperstimulation effects.
requirements: Minimum Perception 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Transitory or Sustained Augmentation of Perception.
compatibility: Duration: One hour. Type: Simple. Sensory and Spiritual Charms tree (Perception-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Sensory and Spiritual Charms' tree, pp. 127-128 (PDF 128-129); visually cross-checked against the Sensory and Spiritual Charms I tree diagram.

name: Deception Recognition Module
summary: A jaw-mounted lie-detector Charm built atop either the Chemical Analysis System or the Tympanal Receptor Upgrade, letting an Alchemical hear vocal tells or scent biochemical signs of deliberate falsehood in speech (or, with an added Optical Enhancement submodule, in written text).
mechanics: Roll Perception + (Awareness or Investigation, whichever is higher) against a difficulty equal to the target's Essence. Success reveals whether the target believes a given statement is true or false; a deliberately misleading half-truth (omitting details a listener would draw wrong conclusions from) reads as false, and a multi-point statement with any false point reads entirely false. With the Microscopic Lens submodule of Optical Enhancement, the same roll can scrutinize written text for deception (difficulty equal to the author's Manipulation rating at time of writing), limited to languages the Exalt understands.
requirements: Minimum Perception 4; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Chemical Analysis System or Tympanal Receptor Upgrade.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Reflexive. Sensory and Spiritual Charms tree (Perception-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Sensory and Spiritual Charms' tree, p. 128 (PDF 129); visually cross-checked against the Sensory and Spiritual Charms I tree diagram, where this Charm is drawn twice (once under each valid prerequisite) as a single node with an either/or prerequisite, per the printed tree layout.

name: Mobile Sensory Drone
summary: A replaced eye that detaches into a tendril-legged automaton sharing all the Exalt's senses and Abilities, telepathically relaying everything it perceives back to her, with seven optional submodules (Autonomous, Communication, Hovering, Injection Needle, Playback, Stealth, Flesh-Burrowing).
